aws_vpc_flow_log.name: cnt_60s

aws_vpc_flow_log.name: nports_60s

aws_vpc_flow_log.name: dir_inbound
aws_vpc_flow_log.source: 1 if direction == inbound. AWS: source external and dest in RFC1918. Cisco: source zone 'outside'

aws_vpc_flow_log.name: dir_outbound
aws_vpc_flow_log.source: 1 if direction == outbound. AWS: source RFC1918 and dest external. Cisco: dest zone 'outside' and source zone not 'outside'

aws_vpc_flow_log.name: proto_tcp
aws_vpc_flow_log.source: 1 if protocol == tcp (AWS 1/6/17 = icmp/tcp/udp; Cisco proto name)

aws_vpc_flow_log.name: proto_udp
aws_vpc_flow_log.source: 1 if protocol == udp (AWS 1/6/17 = icmp/tcp/udp; Cisco proto name)

aws_vpc_flow_log.name: proto_icmp
aws_vpc_flow_log.source: 1 if protocol == icmp (AWS 1/6/17 = icmp/tcp/udp; Cisco proto name)

aws_vpc_flow_log.name: dst_port_logfreq
